SELECT c.cert_id, c.work_id, c.user_id, c.cert_no, c.blockchain_hash, c.cert_url, c.status, c.apply_time, c.cert_time, c.create_time, c.update_time, c.remark, w.title AS work_name, u.nick_name AS user_name FROM sys_copyright_cert c LEFT JOIN sys_work w ON c.work_id = w.work_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE 1=1
AND c.status = #{status}
AND (c.cert_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR w.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY c.create_time DESC

SELECT c.cert_id, c.work_id, c.user_id, c.cert_no, c.blockchain_hash, c.cert_url, c.status, c.apply_time, c.cert_time, c.create_time, c.update_time, c.remark, w.title AS work_name, u.nick_name AS user_name FROM sys_copyright_cert c LEFT JOIN sys_work w ON c.work_id = w.work_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.cert_id = #{certId}
